amends.delta: LaneAdapter.call gains a glm-5.3-apimessages branch: direct HTTPS POST to the frozen endpoint (https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic/v1/messages) via stdlib urllib; body per MODEL_IDENTITY_GLM_ADDENDUM_V1.json invocation_contract (temperature 0.0, max_tokens 8192, no system prompt); Authorization bearer read ONLY from env ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN; success = HTTP 200 with non-empty content[] text (concatenated) => {output, stderr_tail, seconds, rc:0}; any other outcome => {output:'', stderr_tail: <exception type + http status, never headers/body>, seconds, rc:1}. load_freezes() merges MODEL_IDENTITY_FREEZE_V1.json model_identities with MODEL_IDENTITY_GLM_ADDENDUM_V1.json added_model_identities (addendum file must exist; absent = hard error).

--lane choices and echo_check identity iteration switch from reading MODEL_IDENTITY_FREEZE_V1.json directly to campaign_runner_v1.load_freezes() so the merged three-lane identity set (codex, claude, glm) is the single source; echo gate semantics unchanged (same-day, lane-scoped when --lane given).

the three model-identity read sites (lane iteration, emit_matrix model list x2) switch to campaign_runner_v1.load_freezes() merged identity set so the ONE unified eval batch after the 2026-09-07 codex refill covers all lanes including glm-5.3-apimessages; no separate GLM eval instrument is created; scoring path untouched (consumes success_bool only, as before).

adds_artifacts.role: successor addendum to MODEL_IDENTITY_FREEZE_V1.json (parent retained byte-identical, sha256 619fbd2134d66977c4a9ef5a6cedd5f266768901a4e03ae975129d10cbf6af94); freezes model id glm-5.3, endpoint, auth var, sampling params, fail-closed contract for the third study family

verification_plan.pre_any_study_call: same-day echo receipt for lane glm-5.3-apimessages from inside a real sbatch on the execution host: (a) plain echo 'Reply with exactly: ECHO_glm-5.3-apimessages' via --echo-check; (b) gym-shape probe rendering the actual terminal prompt template (dataset tree + mount sentence) and asserting a non-empty, fail-closed-checked reply; both recorded verbatim in the job log
